title.narrative: In 2024, thanks to UNICEF’s support focusing mainly on vaccine management and communication, Madagascar vaccinated cumulatively 26,419,705 children under 15 and 4,598,192 children under 5 during the 3 National Polio Campaigns. In addition, 426,618 zero dose children, aged 12 to 59 months, were vaccinated through the Big Catch-Up initiative.
